description: This file contains the PHP class 'SubscriptionStatus' within the namespace 'Opencart.Catalog.Model.Localisation'. It defines methods for retrieving subscription status data from a database, including fetching a specific status by ID and retrieving all statuses, with caching support.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Model class providing access to subscription status data, with methods to retrieve individual statuses and lists of statuses, with caching.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Fetches a specific subscription status record from the database based on the provided subscription_status_id and current language ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription statuses for the current language, using caching to optimize repeated access.
